name: Chart
purpose: Unified chart wrapper rendering bar, line, and area series as SVG with theme colors consumed only from tokens.
scenarios: Display latency as a line series

series.description: Array of { name, data: number[] } series.

labels.description: Category labels for the x axis.

emptyLabel.description: Text shown when no series has data.

antiPatterns: Do not hardcode hex colors; series paint comes from tokens.
Do not render more than eight series in one chart.

a11y.focus: Chart is not focusable; provide a data table alternative for screen readers.
a11y.labeling: aria-label summarizes the chart; a visually hidden table may mirror the data.

responsive.strategy: SVG scales to container width via viewBox; height keeps a 2:1 ratio.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.

mechanics: Chart paints SVG. Series longer than 96 points are downsampled (first and last samples kept) so DOM node count stays O(paint budget), not O(data). Color comes from token classes, not hex in markup. This is not a WebGL engine.
usage: Import Chart from @chameleon-ui/components. Pass label and series: Array<{ name, data }>.
Use type bar, line, or area. Long feeds are downsampled for paint; do not claim per-sample SVG nodes.
